|game_text=Deploy on table. It’s A Trap! may not be played. Once per game, may use 1 Force to deploy an Effect with “Bespin” or “Cloud City” in lore or game text from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If Chewie, Han, Leia, or Luke wins a battle on Cloud City, place this Effect in Used Pile.
|errata_history=Versions of [[We're The Bait (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds]], in date order (3 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[We're The Bait (V) (Virtual Set 6)]]): the “Final Revised Virtual Set 6” sheet “Virtual Set #6” (Players Committee; announced and tournament-legal 12 January 2004; PDF dated 12 January 2004), page 3, slip 50 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20040619231451/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 19 June 2004; the Committee still hosts the same file as [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards6.pdf VirtualCards6.pdf] on res.starwarsccg.org), announced on the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040415220046/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news page]: “Deploy on table. While Vader present at a Cloud City battleground site, your Force drain and Force drain bonuses at that site may not be canceled. Once per game, you may use 1 Force to ▲ one Effect with “Bespin" or "Cloud City" in the game text. Place this Effect in Used Pile if Luke, Leia, Han, or Chewie wins a battle on Cloud City. A” This is the earliest surviving slip: the first release sheet of 21 November 2003 is not preserved. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “6•50” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[We're The Bait (V) (Virtual Set 6) (Errata)]]): the updated sheet of 12 October 2004 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20050406053829/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%206.pdf Virtual Set 6.pdf] on swccgpc.com, Internet Archive 6 April 2005; PDF dated 12 October 2004; listed on the Committee's Virtual Cards page as “Revised 10/12/2004”), page 3, slip 50, on the same old slip: “Deploy on table. While Vader present at a Cloud City battleground site, your Force drain and Force drain bonuses at that site may not be canceled. Once per game, you may use 1 Force to ▲ one Effect with “Bespin” or “Cloud City” in the game text. Place this Effect in Used Pile if Luke, Leia, Han, or Chewie wins a battle on Cloud City. A” '''What changed:''' ““Bespin"” became ““Bespin””; “"Cloud City"” became ““Cloud City””.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154341/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards6.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 50), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploy on table. It’s A Trap! may not be played. Once per game, may use 1 Force to deploy an Effect with “Bespin” or “Cloud City” in lore or game text from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If Chewie, Han, Leia, or Luke wins a battle on Cloud City, place this Effect in Used Pile.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
